admin_description: The single administrator signs in here. Readers never see this page.
setup_description: Create the single administrator for this site.
recovery_description: Locked out? Reset the admin password with the Recovery Secret from your deployment environment.
setup_failed_description: Check the supplied values or try again later.
setup_success: The admin account was created. The one-time setup code is now permanently disabled.
generic_credentials: Try again. This message stays the same whether the email exists or not.
offline_description: Signing in needs a connection to your Briefly server. Your input is kept.
sessions_revoked: All existing sessions have been revoked — sign in again with the new password.
rotate_secret: Rotate or remove RECOVERY_SECRET from your environment as soon as possible — anyone holding it can reset this account.
recovery_rejected_description: Check the value in your deployment environment. Nothing was changed.
articles_page_description: Each article has one living Draft. Publishing freezes an immutable Publication — editing never touches what’s live.
articles_empty_description: Your first article starts as a private Draft. Nothing goes live until you publish it — deliberately.
articles_load_failed_description: Retry to reload the list. No local or public Article state was changed.
articles_create_failed_description: Nothing was created. Existing Articles are unchanged.
media_page_description: Images referenced by Drafts and Publications.
media_accepted_rules: JPEG · PNG · WebP · AVIF — max 8 MiB, max 8192 px per side, max 8,388,608 px total.
media_not_accepted_rules: SVG, GIF, PDF, audio, video, or other attachments.
unable_to_manage_assets_description: The upload or media library request failed. Please retry.
asset_cleanup_completed_description: The media entry and its stored object are no longer available.
asset_became_referenced_description: Cleanup did not begin. Remove every current Draft usage and every retained Publication reference before trying again.
asset_cleanup_needs_retry_description: The Asset remains visibly pending after a storage failure. Retry the explicit cleanup action; do not attach it to new content.
no_images_yet_description: Upload your first image here, or straight from the editor when you insert a figure.
upload_limits_note: Limits: 8 MiB per file · 8192 px per side · 8,388,608 px total. SVG, GIF, PDF, audio, video and other attachments are rejected before upload.
preview_unavailable_cleanup_pending: Preview unavailable while cleanup is pending
cleanup_failed_body: References were cleared, but the storage delete call failed. The asset stays listed — retry when storage recovers.
cleanup_queued_body: The storage worker is removing the file. This can take a moment on object storage.
referenced_cleanup_blocked_body: Cleanup is only possible when Draft refs and Publication refs are both zero. {referenceStatus}.
no_references_body: Zero Draft refs, zero Publication refs. This asset can be cleaned up — the file is removed and cannot be recovered.
cleanup_confirmation_body: This explicit action removes the stored object and media entry. It is allowed only while both reference counts are zero and cannot retract copies that may already have been distributed.
alt_not_stored_on_asset: Alt text and captions are not stored on the asset — they are set per use, wherever the image is inserted.
asset_reference_status_none: No current Draft or retained Publication references
asset_authoring_intro: Select or upload verified Assets from the library, then describe each use in this Article. Alt text is set per-figure — the same Asset can carry different descriptions in different contexts. Decorative figures save an empty alt value and are skipped by assistive technology.
upload_format_limit: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF · up to 8 MiB.
decorative_figure_empty_alt: Decorative figure (saved with empty alternative text)
caption: Caption
image_upload_verify_failed: The image could not be uploaded or verified.
select_asset_and_cover_alt: Select an Asset and enter meaningful cover alternative text.
select_asset_and_describe_figure: Select an Asset and describe the figure, or mark it decorative.
trash_capability_description: Trash is available now. Restore always returns an Article unpublished; permanent delete requires typing the exact title and cannot be undone.
trash_empty_description: Articles you move to Trash appear here with their full history intact, waiting to be restored or permanently deleted.
trash_load_failed_description: The request failed. Nothing was changed — this is only a display problem.
trash_moved_description: It is absent from normal administration and public Article endpoints. Its recoverable work is intact; restoring it will leave it unpublished.
trash_page_description: Trashed articles keep their Draft, all Publications, slug records and media references — but leave the normal list. Nothing here is public.
trash_purge_error_description: Briefly did not confirm the destructive operation. The Article remains in Trash and can be retried safely.
trash_purge_point_content: The Article, its Draft and all Publications are permanently deleted.
trash_purge_point_media: Media files are not deleted — their references are released.
trash_purge_point_tombstone: Formerly public slugs keep a permanent tombstone: they answer 410 Gone and can never be reused by another article.
trash_purge_type_id: Type the Article ID to confirm
trash_purge_warning: {title} will be destroyed. This cannot be undone.
trash_purged_description: The article, its Draft and all Publications are gone. Its media files were not touched. Formerly public slugs answer 410 Gone and can never be used again.
trash_restore_body: Restore {title} to normal administration? Its Draft and Publication history remain intact and editable, but it will have no Current Publication. You must explicitly publish it again before anonymous Article endpoints can see it.
trash_restore_error_description: Briefly did not confirm the restore. The Article remains in Trash; reload the Trash view and try again.
trash_restored_description: It is back in normal administration as unpublished. Publishing again remains a separate, deliberate act.
trash_verb_move_description: Article leaves the normal list and goes offline — restorable, always returns unpublished.
trash_verb_purge_description: Only possible here in Trash. Cannot be undone.
trash_verb_unpublish_description: Article stays in the normal list — Draft and history kept, republish anytime.
settings_drawer_description: Public content defaults — Articles inherit these unless they override them.
unable_load_settings_description: Refresh the page to try again.
settings_fields_need_attention_descripti: Nothing was saved. Fix the highlighted fields and save again.
couldnt_save_settings_description: The request failed. Your edits are still in the form — retry to send them again.
settings_saved_description: New defaults apply to Articles that inherit them. Articles with overrides are unchanged.
default_public_identity_description: Shown alongside published content. Articles may override any of these per Article.
public_content_note: These values describe public content. They are unrelated to the administrator sign-in email in Account.
account_drawer_description: The single administrator — no other users, roles, or invitations by design.
admin_email_note: Fixed at initialization. This address only signs you in — the public Byline lives in Site Settings.
change_password_description: After a successful change, every existing session is revoked — including this one — and you return to the sign-in page.
unable_change_password_description: Check the current password and new password, then try again.
password_updated_description: All sessions — including this one — have been revoked. Sign in again with the new password.
sign_out_this_session_description: Ends the current browser session only. MFA is not available in this version.
password_updated_notice: Password updated. All sessions were revoked — sign in with the new password.
invalid_byline_url: Use an HTTP or HTTPS URL.
invalid_default_language: Use a valid BCP 47 language tag, such as en or zh-Hans.
